As a result, the name serves as a constant reminder of the deep cultural connection to the natural world and the importance of hard work, productivity, and community in Arab societies.

Bees are mentioned multiple times in the Quran, and their symbolic representation is often associated with hard work and the sweetness of bring blessings (Hudah).
